from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Paper(BaseModel):
    """One provided paper and the titles of other provided papers it cites."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The paper's own title")
    cites_other_provided_papers: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of other papers in the provided collection that are referenced in this paper's bibliography")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    papers: list[Paper]
